risks.title: Fluctuations in operating results
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned first and described as recurring, with direct impact on enterprise value and stock price. The language emphasizes global economic uncertainty, currency fluctuations, geopolitical conflicts (Ukraine, Gaza, India-Pakistan tensions), and dependence on client forecasts. Macro category is heavily weighted in the current context.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and data breaches
risks.score_rationale: Critical risk for an IT company operating in 74 countries. Mentioned in risk factors with severe consequences: financial losses, litigation, reputational damage, operational disruption. Direct impact on service continuity and customer trust.

risks.title: Accelerated adoption of generative AI
risks.score_rationale: Generative and agentic AI are positioned as disruptive to the traditional CX services business model, with potential replacement of human services and margin pressure. The text highlights high adaptation costs and a major competitive risk for a labor-based service provider.

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions and conflicts
risks.score_rationale: Conflicts in Ukraine, Gaza, and Indo-China tensions are explicitly cited. The text links these events to global economic and logistical disruptions. Risk repeated across multiple sections. Direct impact on operations in 74 countries and client demand.

risks.title: Dependence on global operations
risks.score_rationale: Presence in 74 countries with concentrations in the Philippines, India, Egypt, Brazil, and Turkey. Exposed to local instabilities, natural disasters, and currency fluctuations (Philippine peso, Indian rupee, Egyptian pound, Colombian peso, Canadian dollar). Approximately 89% of FY2025 revenue generated outside the United States.

risks.title: Increased competition and insourcing
risks.score_rationale: Risk of market share loss to direct competitors or client insourcing. Digital entrants and pricing pressure are mentioned. High employee turnover increases costs. Competitive market on pricing terms, delivery capacity, and service quality.

risks.title: Emerging AI regulation
risks.score_rationale: Growing regulatory uncertainty around AI, including the EU AI Act and U.S. executive orders. Potential impacts on compliance costs and innovation capabilities in GenAI and agentic solutions. Regulatory category is rising sharply.

ai_positioning.summary: Concentrix is actively integrating generative AI and agentic AI into its CX service solutions, positioning these technologies as key elements of its value proposition. The company explicitly mentions them in its business description and acknowledges both the risks and opportunities associated with their accelerated adoption.
